subjects.title: ZIA SCIM attribute mapping
subjects.lead: ZIA maps these SCIM user attributes: id to a Zscaler-generated unique ID; externalId to scim_externalid; userName to the user ID (login_name) in user@domain ...

subjects.title: What SCIM does when a user is disabled or deleted
subjects.lead: When active=false is sent for a user, Zscaler disables the user; when active=true, Zscaler enables the user.

subjects.title: How SCIM groups and departments land in ZIA
subjects.lead: A SCIM group becomes a Zscaler group: its displayName is the group Name, its externalId is kept as scim_externalid, and Zscaler generates its ID.
